research_question: Does online consequence-driven local state acquisition produce reusable relation identity on development-only novel entities/compositions, beyond equally informed conventional frequency and Bayesian controls?

scope.source: Original deterministic L10 DEV_FIT and DEV_CHECK, 3 existing invented families only
scope.state_inputs: Opaque relation code P0..P2 paired with physical effect sensor channel E0..E2 in sequential DEV_FIT experience; no supervised natural-language target text or hidden semantic case passed to update
scope.semantic_information: Identifiability arises from public effect-channel semantics. This IS supervised/effect-labeled information; no unsupervised-semantic-learning claim.
scope.prediction_input: DEV_CHECK observed edges and effect-channel glossary, but no DEV_CHECK effects, truth case or target text, no direct relation-code lexicon
scope.output: Canonical signed propositions via locally acquired code/effect association
known_limitations: Full contextual cause-and-effect understanding is not tested; each code has stationary fixed channel.
Development families overlap between fitting and checking; not an unfamiliar source-family transfer claim.
Effect semantics are an explicit teaching signal available equally to all learners.
No physical process sandbox for arbitrary callback; only recognized pinned module controls.

methods: prior_semantic_lookup_ceiling (separate extra-information diagnostic, never used as matched comparator)
frozen_tests: DEV_CHECK and prospective role rejected at model-fit
Identical content-addressed events and source/effect information budgets across local learner and conventional controls
Repeated encounters accumulate online state; serialization and state restoration exactly preserve predictions
Recall after novel entity bindings and compositions checked per graph
No-effect information regime must abstain with zero false positives
Permuted effect association must not be mistaken for semantic success
Effects with ties cause abstention (no tie-break semantic invention)
Causal intervention distinguish associative sensitivity, not prove causality
Negative outcomes include unknown mapping, novel meaning absent in fit, noise and interference
Graph success counts abstentions, omissions, extras, wrong sign, and per-family micro/macro
Matched fit and inference CPU/wall time plus state bytes; peak traced memory; no FLOPs/energy unless measured
Independent scorer for exact structured semantics remains L10-A pinned

data_custody.cross_os: sha256 of state and numeric-only receipts must agree

advancement.require: Candidate outperforms equally informed conditional frequency and Bayesian controls across new source family experiments with lower/matched abstention and complete cost; a tie or loss is negative; DEV-only success cannot earn GO.

ckb_plane_authority: no new scheduler/controller/queue or protected promotion
